LoopSemanticDiff — the object model shared by two producers per the WP-1L task brief: (1) an AI-assisted structural edit proposal (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §6, LOOP_PHONE_AUTHORING_SPEC.md §8's BASE_REVISION→PROPOSED→APPLIED/DISCARDED machine, FB-RAT-PHN-006) and (2) a lineage/upstream-comparison diff (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §8/§9, FB-RAT-LIN-004/FB-RAT-LIN-005). Filename note: this work package's SCHEMAS TO WRITE list names the file `loop-semantic-diff.schema.json` (no version segment); the per-schema instructions prose elsewhere calls it `loop-semantic-diff.v1.schema.json` — the file list is treated as authoritative since it is the explicit deliverable enumeration, and this discrepancy is flagged in the authoring report for the Amendments-phase agent, not silently resolved by renaming either party's expectation. Cross-references, does not redefine: loop-validation-rules.v1.json (findings codes), capability-ids.v1.json (authorityLadder, capability IDs).
title: LoopSemanticDiff
description: A categorized semantic diff between a base revision and a proposed/comparison target — nine separate finding categories (FB-RAT-LIN-004, never flattened into one undifferentiated list) plus an independently-surfaced license-change flag and an independently-surfaced authority/verification blocking review group (FB-RAT-LIN-005). Produced either by an AI-assisted edit proposal (sourceKind=AI_PROPOSAL) or a fork/upstream lineage comparison (sourceKind=LINEAGE_COMPARISON) — both are the same reported shape per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §6's proposal fields and LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §8/§9's diff report.

diffId.description: Stable identity for this diff instance (FB-RAT-COM-002 style).

sourceKind.description: AI_PROPOSAL: Distiller/AI-assisted structural edit (§6, FB-RAT-PHN-006) awaiting user approval. LINEAGE_COMPARISON: fork-vs-upstream-parent comparison (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §10's COMPARING→DIFF_READY transition).

semanticOperations.description: §6 'semantic operations' — the flat operation list every categorizedFindings entry below references by opId.

behaviorExplanation.description: §6 'behavior explanation' — human-readable summary of what changes in observed behavior.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

AuthorityRung.description: capability-ids.v1.json's authorityLadder, duplicated locally per this repo's convention rather than cross-file $ref'd.

BaseRevisionRef.description: The 'base revision' this diff was computed against (§6) — either a LoopDraft revision (schemas/loops/loop-draft.schema.json's draftId+revision) or an immutable release identity tuple subset (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §10 'comparison MUST occur only against immutable snapshots').

targetType.description: One of LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §8's nine FB-RAT-LIN-004 categories (license changes are NOT a targetType value here — they are reported only through the sibling `licenseChange` object, per §8's 'MUST additionally be surfaced as its own flag alongside these nine categories, rather than folded into Documentation').

targetId.description: nodeId/edgeId/gatewayId/slotId this operation concerns, when targetType names an addressable graph object; null for definition-wide changes (e.g. objective text).

CategorizedFindings.description: FB-RAT-LIN-004 'Lineage comparison reports node, edge, schema, capability, authority, budget, test, documentation, and compatibility changes separately' — LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §8's exact nine categories, structurally closed (`additionalProperties: false`) so a producer cannot silently add a tenth bucket or flatten two categories together. Each array holds `SemanticOperation.opId` values from `semanticOperations` above — this schema does NOT cross-check that a listed opId's own `targetType` actually matches the category key it is filed under (array of opaque ID strings, no join); see fixtures/loops/loop-semantic-diff/adversarial/ for the resulting schema-valid-but-miscategorized case this leaves open, and LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §8 for the normative 'never flattened' obligation a validator enforces instead.

LicenseChange.description: LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §8: 'A change to the package's declared license MUST additionally be surfaced as its own flag alongside these nine categories, rather than folded into Documentation.' compatibilityFinding feeds LOOP-LINEAGE-002 ('declared license incompatible with parent release license').

DiffValidationResult.description: §6 'validation result' — the post-apply (or post-comparison) validation state, duplicated locally from the same small shape schemas/loops/loop-draft.schema.json's ValidationState uses, per this repo's cross-file convention of duplicating small shared shapes rather than $ref'ing into another document's $defs.

before.description: Null when this capability is newly requested (direction=ADDED).

after.description: Null when this capability is being dropped (direction=REMOVED).

authorityWidening.description: FB-RAT-LIN-005 condition 1: any requested capability's authority rung moves higher, or a new capability is requested above the loop's prior maximum.

verificationWeakening.description: FB-RAT-LIN-005 condition 2: a verifier removed, its severity lowered, or a terminal-state mapping that previously required verification no longer does.

destructivePathIntroduced.description: FB-RAT-LIN-005 condition 3: a new node/edge makes an EXECUTE_DESTRUCTIVE-rung capability reachable that was not reachable before.

schemaBreakage.description: FB-RAT-LIN-005 condition 4: an input/output schema change that is not backward-compatible per LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §7.

acknowledgedByUser.description: MUST be explicitly acknowledged before any operation from this comparison may be applied, and MUST NOT be bundled into a single 'approve all' action that also covers ordinary categorizedFindings (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §9).

BlockingReviewGroup.description: LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md §9 (FB-RAT-LIN-005): four diff conditions pulled OUT of the ordinary nine-category categorizedFindings above into a separate, always-visible, blocking review group. This schema does not itself cross-check that every categorizedFindings.authority/node/edge/schema entry which structurally qualifies as one of these four conditions is actually reflected here — see fixtures/loops/loop-semantic-diff/adversarial/ for the resulting schema-valid-but-dangerous case (a widening operation present in the ordinary findings but silently absent from this independent group).

AuthorityDiffSummary.description: §6 'authority-diff summary', reported independently of ordinary graph changes per FB-RAT-LIN-005 and FB-RAT-PHN-006 ('Authority-widening changes MUST be visually separated from ordinary graph edits, not interleaved with them in one undifferentiated list').
